verdict.rationale: Formant's docs describe event-triggered webhooks that make HTTP calls to any endpoint when a Formant event fires, which is the outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single first-party statement with little detail. Missing for 10: documentation of payload format, signing/authentication, retry behavior, API-based webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.
